claim_one_line: NO THREAD KEEPS A RECORD, VERIFIED ON MAIN (re-banks the SM seat's W34; rule 1915fe928 before script ddd62c4ee before output 47a86fa8b; the table reproduced with main's independent code): at the common point, with coefficients Sym^{2k} rho_Q, the private states (the kernel of restriction to the puncture) have dimensions 0, 4, 2 for k = 1, 2, 3 (= 2 m_0, m_0 the Q8-invariant multiplicity); no thread among the 758 states to word length 12 fixes a private class, in any block, nor does the joint action of L and R (with P and -I added); at rank three L and R each keep one and P keeps two (three at rank four). A thread acts as its hyperbolic matrix tensored with a finite-order map, so it fixes nothing. So a fixed record exists only at an end; a relational record (an invariant relation between changing parts, a non-zero equivariant map) is not excluded and is open. 0 of 19.
